dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: You as well.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 会社に行きたくないんです
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは辛いですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. That must be really tough.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあったのか、お聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about what's been happening?

dialogue.origin: 行ってもあまりやることがないし
dialogue.content: Well, even when I go, there's not much for me to do.

dialogue.origin: それは困りますよね･･
dialogue.content: That sounds frustrating.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: お仕事はどんな内容の仕事でしょうか
dialogue.content: What kind of work do you do?

dialogue.origin: 実験系の会社なのですが、
dialogue.content: It's a company that does research and experiments, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今の部署は実験とかではなくて、正直何をやればいいのかがよく解らないのですそれが辛くて
dialogue.content: My current department doesn't involve experiments, and honestly, I don't really know what I'm supposed to be doing. That's what makes it so hard.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、何をやればいいか分からないのはしんどいですよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand. Not knowing what you're supposed to do must be very stressful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうすると今は実験ではなく、どういった部署におられるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: So if it's not experiments, what kind of department are you in now?

dialogue.origin: 部署が何をやるのか書いた文書を読んでみたのですが、抽象的なので具体的なことはよく解りません研究の調整をやるとか何とか
dialogue.content: I read a document describing what the department does, but it's very abstract, so I don't really understand the specifics. Something about coordinating research.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にやることも少しはあるんですが
dialogue.content: There are a few concrete tasks, though.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: やることが曖昧だと、どうしたらいいの？っておもいますよね、、
dialogue.content: When your tasks are ambiguous, it must make you wonder, "What should I do?"

dialogue.origin: 学会出張の旅費を誰に出すのか決める会議を仕切るとか、論文や学会発表の記録を整理するとか、
dialogue.content: Things like running meetings to decide who gets travel expenses for academic conferences, or organizing records of papers and conference presentations.

dialogue.origin: でもそれだけでは、時間を持て余してしまいます
dialogue.content: But that's not enough to fill the time; I have too much time on my hands.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、仕事がつまらなく感じてしまうのですね、、
dialogue.content: I see, so your work feels tedious.

dialogue.origin: 毎日何しに会社に行ってるのかって思うと虚しいし生きている意味さえ解らなくなってきます
dialogue.content: When I think about why I even go to the office every day, I feel empty, and I even start to lose my sense of purpose in life.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、なんで毎日こんなことしないといけないの？生きている意味も見いだせない感じなのですね、、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, it sounds like you're feeling, 'Why do I have to do this every day?' and can't find meaning in your life.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに何とお呼びしたらよいでしょうか？（性別と年齢も可能でしたらお教えいただけますでしょうか）
dialogue.content: By the way, what should I call you? (And if you're comfortable, could you also tell me your gender and age?)

dialogue.origin: 徹（とおる）でいいです
dialogue.content: You can call me Toru.

dialogue.origin: 徹さんですね、有難うございます
dialogue.content: Toru-san, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今の会社は入社されてどれくらい経ちますか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been with your current company?

dialogue.origin: 20年くらいです
dialogue.content: About 20 years.

dialogue.origin: 20年、長く頑張ってこられたのですね
dialogue.content: Twenty years—that’s a long time. You’ve worked hard.

dialogue.origin: まあ頑張ってたときもありましたね
dialogue.content: Well, there were times when I worked hard.

dialogue.origin: 今はどうしようも
dialogue.content: But now... it feels hopeless.

dialogue.origin: 山あり谷ありといった感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: Would you say it's been a journey of ups and downs?

dialogue.origin: ないですけど
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: うんうん今はやりがいを感じられなくなっているのですね、、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. Right now it feels like you no longer find your work rewarding.

dialogue.origin: いろいろありましたが、今が一番酷いですね
dialogue.content: There have been many things, but this is the worst it's ever been.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今、会社人生で最悪の時期と感じておられるのですね・・・今のようにつまらない仕事をやらされるようになったのは、いつ頃からでしょうか
dialogue.content: So you feel that this is the worst time in your career... When did you start being assigned this kind of tedious work?

dialogue.origin: 1年半くらい前からです
dialogue.content: About a year and a half ago.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね何かきっかけとかはあったのでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. Was there a particular event that triggered this?

dialogue.origin: 前の部署で、部下とのトラブルがあって、室長をしてたんですが、平に降りると言って 部屋を飛び出してしまったんです
dialogue.content: In my previous department, I had a conflict with a subordinate. I was the section chief, but I said I was stepping down to a regular position and stormed out of the room.

dialogue.origin: えっ、、そんなことがあったのですねそれはとても辛いですよね。。
dialogue.content: Oh... that happened. That must have been very painful.

dialogue.origin: 所長から温情で降格を留意されたんですが、
dialogue.content: The director kindly advised me to reconsider the demotion, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 所長もどこに配置するのか迷ったようでが、結局は研究調査室という部屋の室長に落ち着きました
dialogue.content: It seems the director was unsure where to place me, but in the end, I was made the head of a department called the Research and Survey Office.

dialogue.origin: でも、その部屋は私一人しかいなくて、部下のいない室長なんです
dialogue.content: But I'm the only one in that office. I'm a section chief with no subordinates.

dialogue.origin: 毎日壁を眺めながら過ごしています
dialogue.content: I spend my days just staring at the walls.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そんな状況なのですね・・・室長までされていた徹さんが、会社にいるのはとても肩身が狭いですよね、、それは会社に行きたくなくなりますよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand the situation... For you, Toru-san, who had been a section chief, it must feel very awkward at the company. No wonder you don't want to go to work.

dialogue.origin: 薄暗くて窓もない部屋で
dialogue.content: In a dim room with no windows.

dialogue.origin: ええっ！
dialogue.content: What?!

dialogue.origin: そんなところで一日中仕事しろと、、
dialogue.content: And they expect you to work there all day...

dialogue.origin: それは酷過ぎますよね、、
dialogue.content: That's just too cruel.

dialogue.origin: 以前の部署の部下の方とはどんなことがあったのでしょうか？（お話しできる範囲で結構です）
dialogue.content: What kinds of things happened with your subordinate in the previous department? (You only need to share what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.origin: 実験の準備の連絡とかで、言ったとか言わなかったとかコミュニケーションエラーが多かったですね
dialogue.content: There were a lot of communication errors, things like he-said-she-said about preparing for experiments.

dialogue.origin: その前から、更年期鬱みたいになっていた、頭がぼやっとしていたので、部屋を上手く運営できなかったんです
dialogue.content: Even before that, I was feeling something like menopausal depression. My mind was foggy, and I couldn't manage the section effectively.

dialogue.origin: 部長からもそれをチクチクチクチク批難され、部下からは突き上げられて、遂に部屋を出ると言ってしまったんです
dialogue.content: The department head was constantly criticizing me for it, and my subordinate was pushing back, so I finally just said I was leaving the section.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは挟み撃ちで逃げ場が無いと感じてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. It must have felt like you were caught in the middle with nowhere to escape.

dialogue.origin: はい自分で自分にダメだししてしまったんです
dialogue.content: Yes. I just gave up on myself.

dialogue.origin: そんな状況になれば、誰だって逃げ出したくなると思いますよ
dialogue.content: In a situation like that, I think anyone would want to run away.

dialogue.origin: 更年期鬱かもしれないということですが、今はどんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned it might be menopausal depression. How are you feeling now?

dialogue.origin: 他の管理職はちゃんとできているのかって、どうなんだろう今思うと、そこまで責任感じなくてもよかったのかも知れないですけれどね
dialogue.content: I wonder if other managers are doing their jobs properly... Looking back now, maybe I didn't need to feel so responsible.

dialogue.origin: 被ってしまいすみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for interrupting.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、他と比べる必要はないと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, I don't think you need to compare yourself to others.

dialogue.origin: 今も続いています頭がぼーっとしているし、気力がでないし、憂鬱なことが多いです
dialogue.content: It's still continuing. My head feels fuzzy, I have no energy, and I often feel down.

dialogue.origin: 寝付きも悪いです
dialogue.content: I also have trouble falling asleep.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、それはとてもしんどいですよね、、通院とかはされていますか？
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, that must be very hard on you. Are you seeing a doctor?

dialogue.origin: はい部署を変わる半年前くらいからメンタルクリニックに通っています
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been going to a mental health clinic since about six months before I changed departments.

dialogue.origin: お医者さんは何とおっしゃっていますか
dialogue.content: What does your doctor say?

dialogue.origin: 鬱病と言われました
dialogue.content: I was diagnosed with depression.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、仕事続けられるだろうか？と心配になりますよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. It must make you worry about whether you can continue working.

dialogue.origin: それほど重傷ではないので、仕事を休むほどではないと言われました。
dialogue.content: They said it's not severe enough that I need to take time off work.

dialogue.origin: それは少し安心しましたが、ご自身としては辛い状況は変わらないですよね、、
dialogue.content: That's a bit of a relief, but for you, the difficult situation hasn't changed, has it?

dialogue.origin: 徹さんとしては、例えば前の部署に戻るとか、他の部署でやり直したいというお気持はおありでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Toru-san, do you have any desire to, for example, go back to your old department or start over in a different one?

dialogue.origin: 心のダメージが癒えていないので、今はちょっと無理ですねどの面下げて戻ってきたんだ、とか言われそうだし
dialogue.content: The emotional damage hasn't healed, so that's not possible right now. I feel like people would say something like, 'Look who's come crawling back.'

dialogue.origin: うんうん、周りの目を考えると戻りづらいですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, it's hard to go back when you think about what others will think.

dialogue.origin: 突然部屋を出たことでも随分迷惑をかけましたしね
dialogue.content: And I caused a lot of trouble by suddenly leaving the section.

dialogue.origin: そのことを今でも気にかけていらっしゃるのですね、、
dialogue.content: You're still concerned about that.

dialogue.origin: 少しお話整理してよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I take a moment to summarize what we've discussed?

dialogue.origin: 分野の違う人が変わりに室長になってみんな大変だったみたいですもっとも、その人自身は出世が早まったんですけどね
dialogue.content: Someone from a different field became the section chief in my place, and it seems everyone had a hard time. Although, that person got a promotion out of it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、徹さんは周りの方に気遣いのできる優しい方なのですね
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. It sounds like you are a kind person who is very considerate of others, Toru-san.

dialogue.origin: 以前の部署で室長をしていたが部下とトラブルで研究調査室に異動し、1年半くらい前から雑用のような仕事をさせられている
dialogue.content: You were a section chief in your previous department, but after a conflict with a subordinate, you were transferred to the Research and Survey Office and have been given menial tasks for the past year and a half.

dialogue.origin: 迷惑をかけたことは間違いないですけどね
dialogue.content: But there's no doubt I caused trouble.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: うんうん私は、徹さんはとても責任感の強い方だと思います
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. I think you are a very responsible person, Toru-san.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんねいい加減な室長もいますからね
dialogue.content: Perhaps. There are some irresponsible section chiefs out there.

dialogue.origin: そうですよ、そんな上司に比べたら前の部署の方を気に掛ける徹さんはとても素晴らしいと思います
dialogue.content: Exactly. Compared to bosses like that, the fact that you care about your former department is wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 自分を責めすぎるのかもしれないと思うときもあります
dialogue.content: Sometimes I think I might be too hard on myself.

dialogue.origin: でも今の給料泥棒みたいな、働き方はっぱり申し訳なくてしかたがないです
dialogue.content: But this way of working, like I'm just stealing my salary, I just feel so guilty about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、今はそんな風に感じておられるのですね、、
dialogue.content: I see. That’s how you’re feeling right now.

dialogue.origin: そんな徹さんに少しご提案があるのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In that case, Toru-san, I have a small suggestion for you, if that's okay.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 徹さんは、これまで会社に認められて室長になれるくらいまで仕事を頑張ってこられました
dialogue.content: Toru-san, you've worked hard enough to be recognized by your company and become a section chief.

dialogue.origin: ただ、前の部署で部下とのちょっとしたコミュニケーションの行き違いと、上から下からの突き上げで部屋を飛び出してしまいました
dialogue.content: However, you stormed out of your section because of a small communication mix-up with a subordinate and pressure from both above and below.

dialogue.origin: 概ねそうですね
dialogue.content: That’s mostly correct.

dialogue.origin: 私はその部下の方と合わなかっただけだと感じましたが、ご自身はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: I felt that perhaps you and that subordinate simply weren’t a good match—how do you see it?

dialogue.origin: （もう少しやっても大丈夫でしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (Is it alright if we continue for a little longer?)

dialogue.origin: 部下もキツかったですが、私の指示が口頭が多かったので、文書で記録を残しておけばよかったのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: My subordinate was difficult, but my instructions were often verbal, so perhaps I should have kept written records.

dialogue.origin: 10分くらいなら延長してもいいですよ
dialogue.content: Extending for about 10 minutes is fine.

dialogue.origin: （有難うございます）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、その一件で貴重な学びを得たのですね
dialogue.content: I see—so you gained a valuable lesson from that incident.

dialogue.origin: そんな徹さんが、部屋を出たからと言って、仕事をやり切る力、周りへの気遣い、責任感といった徹さんの持ち味や会社における価値は何も変わらないと思います
dialogue.content: Just because you left that section, I don't think it changes your inherent strengths—your ability to get work done, your consideration for others, your sense of responsibility—or your value to the company.

dialogue.origin: 今から思うとって行くことが有りますね
dialogue.content: Looking back now, there are things I realize.

dialogue.origin: 言うことがありますね
dialogue.content: Yes, looking back, I can see that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そこから学ぶ姿勢が素晴らしいと思います今はまだ鬱の症状がありますが、もう少し症状が改善したら部署異動を希望するというのはいかがでしょうか？会社も徹さんの力は知っているので応えてくれると思うですが
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, your willingness to learn from it is wonderful. I know you still have symptoms of depression, but once they improve a little, how about requesting a department transfer? The company knows your capabilities, so I think they would be responsive.

dialogue.origin: こんなに働きが悪いのに、戻してもらえるんだろうか？首にならないのが不思議なくらいなんですけどね
dialogue.content: With my performance this poor, would they really take me back? It's a miracle I haven't been fired.

dialogue.origin: （時間延長すみませんでした、この後終了まで勝手に一人で続けたいと思います、どうも有難うございました！）
dialogue.content: (Sorry for the time extension. I'd like to continue on my own until the end. Thank you very much!)

dialogue.origin: （最後まで出来ず申し訳ございませんでした）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry we couldn't finish to the end.)

dialogue.origin: どうもありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 参考になりました
dialogue.content: This was helpful.

dialogue.origin: （恐縮です、有難うございます！）
dialogue.content: (I'm humbled, thank you!)

dialogue.origin: 確かに今の部署ではそう感じるかもしれませんね、、ただ、部署が変わって仕事が変われば本来の力を徹さんは発揮できると私は感じました
dialogue.content: It's true you might feel that way in your current department. However, I feel that if you were to change departments and your work changed, you would be able to demonstrate your true abilities, Toru-san.

dialogue.origin: ですので、今はこれまで仕事を頑張ってきたことに対するちょっとした休養期間と捉えて、次のステージに向けてのステップと捉えてみるのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Therefore, how about viewing this time as a short rest period for all the hard work you've done, and as a step towards the next stage?

dialogue.origin: ほんとに会社が首にしたいなら、わざわざ研究調査室を作ってそこの長としてのポストを用意することはしなかっただろうと私は思いました
dialogue.content: I believe that if the company truly wanted to fire you, they wouldn't have gone to the trouble of creating a Research and Survey Office and preparing a position as its head for you.

dialogue.origin: 会社も徹さんの復帰を望んでいるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Isn't it possible the company is also hoping for your return?

dialogue.origin: ですので、是非今の充電期間をこれまで頑張ってきた権利として受けとっていただきたいと思います気遣いのできる徹さんですから、会社に悪いなと思うかもしれませんが、ちょうど今は部下もいないわけですし、これまでのご仕事を振り返ってみるでもいいです、これからのステップに向けて新たなこと（資格など）に挑戦するのもいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Therefore, I would like you to accept this recharging period as a right you've earned through your hard work. Being the considerate person you are, you might feel bad towards the company, but you don't have any subordinates right now. You could use this time to reflect on your career so far, or how about trying something new (like getting a certification) for your next step?

dialogue.origin: これまで仕事を頑張って認められ、周りへの気遣い、責任感の強いのある徹さんならきっと出来ると私は思います
dialogue.content: As someone who has worked hard, gained recognition, is considerate of others, and has a strong sense of responsibility, I am certain you can do it, Toru-san.

dialogue.origin: 今は心身を休めつつ、是非新しいステップに進んでいくことを心から応援しております
dialogue.content: For now, please rest your mind and body, and know that I am wholeheartedly supporting you as you move on to a new stage.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日のご相談終了させていただきたいと思いますが、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: With that, I would like to conclude today's session, if that is alright.

dialogue.origin: ご相談どうも有難うございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much for sharing with me today.

topic.sub: 鬱病による仕事に対する意欲の低下
